metadata.note: Does omit_drivers also keep the DKMS-built NVIDIA modules out of the initramfs? The GE63 rehearsal proved it for nvidia-open, whose modules live in usr/lib/modules/<kver>/extramodules/. The torre runs nvidia-open-dkms, which builds into updates/dkms/ instead — a different path, so the answer was an inference until this config measured it. Mirrors the torre: NO `drivers` block (nvidia-open and nvidia-open-dkms both provide nvidia and would conflict), the packages named explicitly, and an encrypted root so dasik turns dracut's hostonly on, which is what pulls the modules in. Public test passphrase 'hibpass'. NOT for real hardware.

files.content:
# Managed by dasik. Keep the NVIDIA modules OUT of the initramfs: hostonly
# dracut honours nvidia-utils' modules-load.d file and pulls them in, dragging
# the GSP firmware with them. omit_drivers wins over add_drivers/force_drivers.
omit_drivers+=" nvidia nvidia_modeset nvidia_uvm nvidia_drm "
